state:Andhra Pradesh.text: Andhra Pradesh has aggressively advanced its technology ecosystem by partnering with major firms like Google, Reliance, and IBM to establish massive AI data centres, green infrastructure, and skill development initiatives [R1349768b, Ra3f43300, R9fe15d9b]. The state government has integrated artificial intelligence across numerous public sectors, implementing AI-driven tools for tax administration, policing, disaster forecasting, and healthcare delivery [Ra460605d, R6e71a6d9, Rbf6930ab]. Furthermore, educational reforms have introduced mandatory AI training for teachers and plans to incorporate AI into the school curriculum [Re98842fe, R5b8eaddb].

state:Bihar.text: The Bihar government officially approved the Bihar Artificial Intelligence Policy 2026 to attract AI companies, offer incentives to startups, and position the state as an AI hub [R6548ec46]. To build a modern technical and educational ecosystem, the state partnered with major technology firms like Google, Microsoft, and Sarvam AI to train government school teachers, technical institution staff, and youth in AI skills [Reb7bfdb3, R1b5b6306, Rd689de87]. Furthermore, administrative capabilities and public services are being transformed through sovereign AI infrastructure, AI-driven land dispute committees, upcoming call centres for hospital OPD bookings, and automated traffic cameras [Rbc0f7b3c, Rdc0edc3a, R79e87d3a, Rbf87bb98]. Private investments are also expanding into the region, notably highlighted by CtrlS announcing a ₹10,000 crore investment to establish an AI data centre in the state [Rd3f465ac].

state:Gujarat.text: The state of Gujarat has actively advanced its artificial intelligence ecosystem through major infrastructure investments, policy frameworks, and targeted educational initiatives. Key developments include the establishment of specialized data center policies focusing on green AI capacity [R43f4ae2b, R0d737a25], statewide GPUaaS frameworks [Rd1b68bba], and partnerships with global tech firms for training and research [Re43fd68f, R3520c252]. Additionally, the government has integrated AI into diverse public domains ranging from agricultural procurement [Re71562c3] and police surveillance hackathons [R28ccc09b] to student skills missions [Ra6932da2], while the High Court has addressed judicial limitations by prohibiting AI use in decision-making and flagging non-existent case laws [Rbd9766bd, R3cc78d30].

state:Karnataka.text: Karnataka has pursued an extensive artificial intelligence agenda, establishing Centers of Excellence, planning a dedicated AI university, and approving regional AI hubs and labs [Ra4c0792f, R0e4ecbd7, Rb7265c49, Rb1015546]. The state government has integrated AI into public administration and education, introducing technology training and vocational subjects in schools alongside citizen service projects with private partners [R3e7508f6, Ra61ec765, Rff273deb]. International and domestic collaborations with entities like Anthropic and ElevenLabs have further driven the development of local AI infrastructure and governance frameworks [R34c35c9b, Rff273deb, R9b3c768e].

state:Maharashtra.text: Maharashtra has actively integrated artificial intelligence across governance, infrastructure, and public services, highlighted by the approval of the AI Policy 2026 and major investments like the Tata AI Innovation City and green data centre hubs [R562864e1, Rf8ceda95, Re0b416d1]. The state government has deployed sovereign AI tools through partnerships with Sarvam AI, rolled out AI-driven administrative and monitoring portals, and established dedicated governance committees to oversee educational and policy implementation [R68fee1a0, R3f8abae4, Ree1091c8]. Additionally, AI applications have been adopted for law enforcement, public safety, power theft detection, and agricultural initiatives such as the MahaAgri-AI Policy [R04592b70, Radc0ac36, Rda0dbcb5, Raeae69fa].

state:Odisha.text: Odisha is actively building its artificial intelligence infrastructure through massive investments in semiconductor units, sovereign compute projects, and AI-optimized data centres led by firms like HCLTech, Adani Group, and SentraForge AI [R31b27cb7, R78b0f274, R00b3c6a6, R69c4b40c]. The state government has also rolled out the Odisha Artificial Intelligence Policy 2025 alongside various institutional partnerships with entities like Sarvam AI to establish a Sovereign AI Park and national compute grid [Rc729937b, Rdf1e1271, R230b6e3b]. Furthermore, AI integration is expanding across public administration and citizen services, featuring WhatsApp-based governance and safety chatbots, automated traffic enforcement, and specialized surveillance in forests, prisons, and educational examinations [Rd731fc75, R478c8c67, R8a2dd09f, R499f4234, R05090e42]. To support this technological shift, the state is heavily reforming its education sector by introducing AI curricula, robotics labs, and specialized training programs across schools and higher education institutions [Rdb5da3c5, R7b1537aa, R47f5da8c, R7b9bb8d3].

state:Punjab.text: Punjab has pursued extensive artificial intelligence integration across education, governance, policing, and agriculture. The state introduced an AI curriculum for classes spanning from school grades to mainstream subjects, accompanied by teacher training and student hackathons [Rf6319e99, Re45fa955, Rc24de481]. In law enforcement and public safety, the Punjab Police and security forces deployed smart tools, real-time tracking, AI-driven command centers, and weather-monitoring networks to crack down on organized crime and manage road safety [R7333c0ad, R132d8a77, Re289fcd5]. Meanwhile, agricultural initiatives leveraged AI for farming advisories and productivity, and the state positioned Mohali as an emerging tech and AI hub with specialized infrastructure [R609b6fc5, Red49a495, R83b1fa54].

state:Tamil Nadu.text: Tamil Nadu has rolled out an extensive artificial intelligence roadmap, anchored by its 2026-27 budget and technology plans, to drive economic growth and public service delivery [Rd8653bb5, R33fbd5a6]. Key structural initiatives include plans to establish a 1,000-acre AI city, state-owned GPU clusters, specialized AI centers of excellence, and a sovereign AI park in partnership with Sarvam AI [R1b6cbab3, R472c3c1a, R8b2c535d]. The state is also integrating AI into education and governance through teacher training programs, the deployment of WhatsApp chatbots like 'Namma Arasu' and 'NalamAI' for public services, and AI-driven systems for traffic monitoring and wildlife protection [R576baa19, Rfe24cede, Rc4124c01, Ra4ab0747].

state:Telangana.text: Telangana has actively pursued artificial intelligence integration across infrastructure, governance, and public services, establishing dedicated frameworks like the Telangana AI Innovation Hub and launching the AI Saksham initiative to train government employees [Rd6f74125, Rafe9a4a2, R59295049]. The state has driven major digital and physical infrastructure developments, including massive data center investments by companies like TCS HyperVault and Microsoft alongside specialized green skills and AI centers of excellence [R5b4a7a80, Ra0d04f11, R998e03d5]. Furthermore, the government has incorporated AI tools into public administration for tracking GST compliance, upgrading emergency response services, and modernizing transport and traffic management systems [R849548ed, R867da268, R2fafc184].

state:Uttar Pradesh.text: Uttar Pradesh is rapidly advancing its technology ecosystem by establishing robotics and AI hubs, data centers, and major infrastructure projects in cities like Greater Noida and Lucknow [Rb1cbd4df, R14c6a506]. The state cabinet has formally approved the UP Artificial Intelligence Mission alongside comprehensive startup and skill development policies to boost employment and digital governance [Rb312992b, R4f560368]. Furthermore, the government is integrating AI across various public sectors—deploying AI surveillance for examinations and security, launching specialized training initiatives for youth, and emphasizing responsible AI use in administration and forensic sciences [R840f85d3, Rdbe0daa1, Rea629fd5, R8b1062f4].

category:strategy_policy.text: State governments across India have increasingly focused on formulating comprehensive AI policies, missions, and infrastructure frameworks to drive digital growth. Key initiatives include Rajasthan and Maharashtra approving their respective AI policies [R6a6bee70, R562864e1], Chhattisgarh launching a ₹500 crore AI Mission focused on skill development and governance [R7cc53f61], and Uttar Pradesh clearing an AI mission targeting startups and youth skilling [Rb312992b]. Additionally, several states are developing specialized tech hubs, data centers, and educational reforms, such as Karnataka proposing a public AI university and school-level AI curricula [Rb77b1a7f], and Gujarat introducing data center and AI training policies [Re041bd74, Ra6932da2].

category:regulation_ethics.text: Several state governments and high courts have introduced policies and committees to promote ethical AI use and protect data privacy, such as Rajasthan's AI-ML Policy and Karnataka's AI governance committee [R6a6bee70, R9b3c768e]. Judicial bodies have actively intervened in legal processes, with the Gujarat and Punjab and Haryana High Courts prohibiting the use of AI tools for decision-making and judgment drafting after instances involving AI-generated non-existent case laws [Rbd9766bd, R3cc78d30, R8eacd504]. States are also regulating AI deployment in public administration and education, including Telangana restricting tax officers from uploading confidential data to unauthorized AI platforms, Mizoram barring schools from sharing student data with AI tools without approval, and Maharashtra forming panels to regulate wearable AI devices [R607d069a, R0b53b3df, Re59aa344]. Furthermore, authorities are addressing the challenges of deepfakes, cyber safety, and copyright protection through new protocols, legal reviews, and mandatory content labeling [Raf4f7b8d, R371d634c, R783d943c].

category:funding_budget.text: State governments have heavily financed artificial intelligence infrastructure and governance through large-scale capital allocations, data center investments, and multi-crore policy missions. Significant funding initiatives include Chhattisgarh and Maharashtra approving dedicated ₹500 crore AI missions [R7cc53f61, Rdbb33aa8], Uttar Pradesh clearing a ₹1,725 crore skill and AI initiative [R0c270c1c, R47a5f920], and large private capital agreements spanning massive data center and compute projects in states like Odisha, Andhra Pradesh, and Bihar [Rd3f465ac, R00b3c6a6, R3eefbde9]. Furthermore, specific budgets have targeted public services and skilling, such as Maharashtra allocating ₹11.26 crore to deploy sovereign AI tools [R68fee1a0], Gujarat planning a ₹20 crore mission for student training [Ra6932da2], and Kerala setting aside ₹10 crore for Malayalam AI alongside startup funding [Rfa9c1de2].

category:infrastructure.text: Indian state governments are significantly expanding their artificial intelligence infrastructure by approving and establishing numerous data centres, compute hubs, and specialized technology parks [R31b27cb7, R212c0bcb, Rf8ceda95]. Key initiatives include major investments in large-scale green AI data centres and compute capabilities in states like Andhra Pradesh, Telangana, Gujarat, and Odisha [R3eefbde9, R43f4ae2b, R00b3c6a6]. Furthermore, states are actively developing specialized urban tech hubs, AI cities, and university campuses dedicated to frontier technologies and research [R1b6cbab3, Rb1cbd4df, R2d894836]. Alongside physical infrastructure, several states are also launching localized GPU infrastructure, cloud frameworks, and centers of excellence to bolster domestic AI capabilities [R936eb0aa, Rd1b68bba, Ra4c0792f].

category:partnership.text: Indian state governments have actively pursued partnerships and memorandums of understanding (MoUs) with domestic and international technology firms to drive artificial intelligence infrastructure, governance, and educational initiatives [R65d2a417, R223baf38, Rad868781]. Major investments focus on large-scale AI data centers and compute hubs, with states like Andhra Pradesh, Uttar Pradesh, Maharashtra, and Bihar securing multibillion-dollar projects involving companies such as Google, Reliance, and CtrlS [R1349768b, Rd3f465ac, Re0b416d1, Rad45bc42]. Additionally, several states are collaborating with tech leaders and academic institutions to integrate AI into public services, healthcare, and education through teacher training programs, automated chatbots, and specialized skill development [Reb7bfdb3, R2c127a87, R494484b4, R132d8a77].

category:deployment.text: Indian state governments are actively deploying artificial intelligence across a wide range of public services, governance, and administrative functions. Major initiatives include the implementation of AI-powered portals, chatbots, and digital tools for citizen engagement, tax enforcement, law enforcement, and agricultural monitoring [Rd731fc75, R68fee1a0, Ra61ec765]. Several states have also launched targeted hardware and infrastructure deployments, such as AI-ready computers and specialized platforms, to expand local access and improve regional administrative efficiency [R3590a0eb, Rd2e6b41c, R7ec03dda]. Furthermore, specialized AI deployments are tackling specific state challenges like disaster management, public safety, healthcare screening, and multilingual service delivery [Rd78856c5, Ra460605d, Rf88612cd].

category:skilling.text: State governments have heavily prioritized AI skilling and education by integrating artificial intelligence into school curricula, launching foundational learning programs, and establishing technical training hubs [Rf6319e99, R8176ca19, R3e7508f6]. Initiatives include large-scale educator training partnerships with technology firms, vocational updates in industrial training institutes, and specialized centers of excellence designed to build future-ready workforces across various states [Reb7bfdb3, R6843cc3b, R01ac3f97]. Furthermore, several states have reported notable achievements, such as Andhra Pradesh leading in AI and Big Data skilling under the FutureSkills PRIME program [Rb7d37144].

category:events_outreach.text: States across India have actively engaged in organizing summits, tech conferences, and hackathons focusing heavily on artificial intelligence and emerging technologies [R6abb0164, R1cca094f]. Prominent events like the Bengaluru Tech Summit, Vibrant Gujarat Global Summit, and various regional AI impact conferences serve as primary platforms to showcase innovation ecosystems, attract investments, and drive digital governance [R84a7e58c, R1cca094f, R75f28785]. Additionally, state governments are fostering grassroots technical talent through specialized boot camps, robotics challenges, and police surveillance hackathons [Rb8c534c6, R28ccc09b, Rb65d3208].

state:Kerala.text: The Kerala government has undertaken a sweeping administrative overhaul, formally rebranding its IT department to focus on artificial intelligence, deep tech, and future technologies [Ref58a154, R0182578b]. Significant initiatives include launching an AI Centre of Excellence in Thiruvananthapuram, partnering for social welfare delivery, and introducing AI-driven systems across public services, education, and policing [Rd47ca5ca, R7c7487cf, Ra38669c1]. Major investments feature a ₹52,600 crore agreement by Solstice Data to establish AI-driven data centre facilities in the state [Ra525c46d].

category:governance_body.text: State governments have established specialized ministerial portfolios and administrative departments dedicated to artificial intelligence, with states like Kerala and Tamil Nadu appointing dedicated AI ministers and restructuring their IT departments [R6bbe2d82, Ref58a154, R1b255da2]. Various states have also formed targeted committees, advisory councils, and expert panels to oversee ethical AI adoption, higher education integration, and standard operating procedures for new technologies [R9b3c768e, R3f8abae4, R40c3cafc]. Additionally, law enforcement and security agencies across multiple states are creating internal tech cells and task forces to drive AI-based policing and combat corruption [Ra1409382, R6e827395, R52b2a7e8].

overall.text: Indian state governments have actively pursued artificial intelligence policies, infrastructure investments, and educational initiatives since late 2025. States such as Rajasthan, Maharashtra, and Gujarat have approved formal AI-ML policies and framework guidelines [R6a6bee70, R562864e1, Rbd9766bd], while major investments are driving the establishment of AI data centres and tech hubs in states like Odisha, Andhra Pradesh, Uttar Pradesh, and West Bengal [R31b27cb7, R1349768b, Rb1cbd4df, Rf93d2652]. Additionally, numerous states are integrating AI into public services, police modernization, and foundational school curricula [Rf6319e99, R04592b70, R27258895].

state:Assam.text: Assam is actively integrating artificial intelligence across governance, healthcare, education, and environmental management, highlighted by the launch of an artificial intelligence roadmap, the commissioning of its first government-owned GPU cluster, and partnerships with entities like Google [Red858166, R936eb0aa, R4203359c]. In the education sector, the state has initiated extensive teacher training programs alongside MoUs with firms and IIT Madras to deploy artificial intelligence tools in schools [R49bc3f02, Red858166, Re167bad2]. Healthcare and public safety initiatives feature artificial intelligence platforms for cancer screening, patient monitoring, flood rescue via WhatsApp, and AI-enabled surveillance to prevent human-elephant conflicts and forest encroachment [R06781a1f, R9c52da90, R22629c10, Ra093ebca, R5068779c]. Additionally, administrative advancements include the launch of the 'ALISA' platform at the legislative assembly secretariat and the deployment of language access through BHASHINI [R97060465, Rdc7ff729].

state:Chhattisgarh.text: Chhattisgarh is actively advancing its digital economy and governance through a newly approved Rs 500 crore AI Mission and major planned infrastructure investments, including a significant AI data center project [R7cc53f61, R28218dab]. The state government has integrated artificial intelligence across multiple sectors such as education, policing, and wildlife conservation, partnering with entities like Google India for teacher training and deploying smart surveillance systems in tiger reserves [Rd2fe75d0, R6c86e7f3]. Furthermore, initiatives like mobile science buses, ITI modernization, and specialized learning modules are being utilized to equip youth and tribal students with technology-driven skills [R8ae280e0, Ra5541f51, R5fcb3ecb].

state:Haryana.text: Haryana has actively integrated artificial intelligence across governance, public services, and law enforcement, highlighted by the launch of the Haryana AI Mission and planned AI hubs in Gurugram and Panchkula [Ra92a52de, R2fc878d0]. The state government has adopted AI tools for public grievance pilots, healthcare screening such as TB detection, land revenue chatbots, and drone-driven surveillance for environmental and construction monitoring [R127f881c, R4f453e9d, Rdb9464b3, Rf90e65a4]. Additionally, law enforcement and administrative bodies have introduced AI initiatives to tackle cybercrime, financial fraud, and police modernization under a broader Vision 2030 roadmap [R770d942f, R00f487ea, R448340e7]. Education and workforce development have also seen a significant push through AI-linked skills training, upgraded vocational courses, and AI literacy programs [Rcd5e27a7, R2fc878d0, R0f2e0015].

state:Himachal Pradesh.text: Himachal Pradesh has integrated artificial intelligence across governance, education, public safety, and environmental management. Significant actions include launching the 'Padhai with AI' app, deploying AI-based document verification on the Him Seva Portal, and implementing AI-enabled forest intelligence and ecological restoration platforms [Rb23a865a, R38e56e62, Re6fc0429, Rc1ad1a5c]. Additionally, the state has advanced initiatives in healthcare through robotic surgery and AI medical education plans, while addressing public safety via mobile drug detection systems and warnings against deepfake scams [R60d85513, R7c00393c, R61e5504f, R19aa9a66].

state:Jharkhand.text: Jharkhand has advanced its technology landscape through the launch of the Jharkhand AI Policy 2026 to revolutionize public governance, alongside major investment drives and Memorandums of Understanding worth Rs 87,000 crore [R2269e1a7, R4b4e0b34]. The state is actively integrating artificial intelligence across multiple sectors, establishing AI-powered learning platforms in schools, technical education centers, and dedicated data labs under the IndiaAI Mission [Rd25878d1, R8022329a, R2bcd8e33]. Significant digital interventions span healthcare modernizations with Google partnerships, MSME business health tools, wildlife conflict monitoring using AI cameras, and judicial data center upgrades [Rb7cd9ee5, Rf2b0c1cd, Re675872a, R75cf7a06, R34f9ee5c].

state:Madhya Pradesh.text: Madhya Pradesh has actively pursued AI integration across governance, infrastructure, and public services, highlighted by strategic partnerships with Google Cloud and initiatives like the phased state AI mission [R6473839f, R36eaafc7]. Significant infrastructure investments include plans for AI-ready data-centre campuses, semiconductor facilities, and a dedicated AI city development in Bhopal [Rac12a0cd, R4df0843d, Rd16736d8]. Furthermore, the state has deployed artificial intelligence for diverse practical applications, ranging from monitoring civic purchases and detecting municipal anomalies to wildlife conservation and multilingual public service delivery [Rc72ca0e9, R4c96f220, R1199f2d8].

state:Manipur.text: The state government of Manipur has advanced artificial intelligence integration across digital governance, education, and security, emphasizing a privacy-first approach and partnering with Microsoft [R8e91e0e8, Rdc31ca32, R1838e491]. Key initiatives include signing an MoU with the Digital India BHASHINI Division to expand multilingual AI, launching the AI-powered language translation app 'Ishaan' by IIIT-Manipur, and exploring AI applications to curb wildlife trafficking [Rad868781, R7249ca9d, R49d826c3]. Additionally, AI adoption has been highlighted in tribal development, digital tourism, and academic workshops [R3413274d, Re9f95033, R546f135d].

state:Meghalaya.text: Meghalaya is actively integrating artificial intelligence into governance, education, and public services, highlighted by initiatives such as the drafting of a new IT policy focused on AI and global capability centres [R9625f972, Radc3741c]. The state has introduced AI-enabled learning in select government schools, launched the AI-powered CM IMPACT guidebook, and proposed a Rs 20 crore AI Centre of Excellence at Shillong Technology Park [R24be49c9, Rf277c3a3, R5f7260ed]. Additionally, Meghalaya is utilizing AI applications for farming support, landslide mapping, and digital governance models like the GeoAI-powered edGrid [R73c7e0d9, Rf1f88f85, Rfbdf90e5]. Key events such as the Regional Artificial Intelligence Impact Conference have further marked the state's push toward inclusive tech growth and rural skill development [Rd7994ab1, Rc935224b, R84a1eeb7].

state:Tripura.text: Tripura has advanced significantly in artificial intelligence governance, notably planning to launch India's first state AI policy and partnering with Google India and IIT Kharagpur to build a comprehensive AI ecosystem and innovation hub [Rc68da9b5, R33168f25, R9435f1d2]. The state has integrated AI extensively across the education sector, introducing free AI courses and an AI skill initiative for students, setting up robotics labs, and launching an AI-powered school monitoring system [R3fff65a8, R20047d48, R12023632, R311a6da8]. Furthermore, Tripura has expanded AI applications into public health through a memorandum of understanding with the Centre for AI-powered medical devices and upgraded police traffic management using AI technology [R2235629e, R8edb04a8, R52c24900]. Additional workforce development includes targeted AI training programs to expand employment opportunities for women and trainees [09052bba, Rb70cb3d9].

state:Uttarakhand.text: Uttarakhand has advanced its artificial intelligence initiatives through multiple summits and policy actions, starting with the launch of the AI Mission-2025 policy [R6ff3204d] and major events like the Devbhoomi AI Summit 2026 [Rfcd6274a, R8a719696]. The state government has integrated AI across various sectors, deploying it for wildlife conservation, human-wildlife conflict mitigation, forest acoustic surveillance, and rare bird habitat protection in divisions like Haldwani [R994e0e10, Rf32d6d42, R82962675, Rc5ed6b10]. Additionally, AI is being utilized to curb tax evasion, improve governance and disaster response, launch educational programs like 'AI-for-All' and 'AI on Wheels', and preserve local languages through a new voice portal [R42cd5368, Recb1f69d, R35780311, Rc918dbde, R3158dd4a]. State authorities have also addressed emerging challenges by issuing public advisories on AI voice cloning fraud and busting digital call center scams [R2acb7d3c, R805bb117].

state:West Bengal.text: West Bengal is actively driving industrial revival and economic growth through strategic policy reforms and major investments in AI, data centres, and the Silicon Valley project [Rf93d2652, R0c1ea7de, R2434d991, R1ada3e48]. Significant governance actions include establishing police AI cells, launching AI-powered helplines, and developing AI applications for criminal investigations and urban infrastructure services [R6e827395, Rebcdd9ec, R904a08ab, R08e415eb]. The state is also heavily promoting education and workforce readiness by introducing school modernization pushes, AI curricula, and training partnerships with entities like Oracle [Rde3629a0, Rac4428c1].

state:Rajasthan.text: Rajasthan has actively advanced its artificial intelligence initiatives through policy approvals, digital governance platforms, and targeted public sector applications [R6a6bee70, Rcaf01e51]. Significant actions include implementing AI systems for agricultural advisories, traffic management, wildlife surveillance, and public grievance redressal alongside rolling out foundational AI education courses for citizens and teachers [R1603c33d, Rc500924d, Race990f9, R8f109e77, R2c694631]. The state has also utilized AI for healthcare programs such as diabetes and tuberculosis tracking, as well as deploying facial recognition technology for policing and exams [Rd7e6b721, Re141ed2f, R0d19612d].
